targetTasks.summary: Current window: AlembicPlugin. Claim only task rg8-plugin-commit-driven-unified-evolution-t1 under stateRoot .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-evolution-optimization-2026-06-21. Context: RG-4 Plan-driven generation/test mode is accepted; RG-5 ProjectContext anchored creation is accepted; RG-6 vector availability is accepted in Core+Plugin; RG-7 create/evolve immediate freshness is accepted at AlembicPlugin commit d0ff86f3ab407370b2e903c79dff0397c21b5bfc and AlembicCore commit a156e0d796d396e02d815ca22147c83d59bf880b. Goal: implement RG-8 Plugin commit-driven unified evolution, so ordinary Alembic tool calls compare last seen commit to HEAD and route changed code through one evolution path for新增/保鲜/维护: rename/move automatic source_ref repair, modified logic -> evolution proposal, deleted covered code -> deprecation proposal, and new module/area -> scoped scan/recommendation signal. Required behavior: (1) Inspect current Plugin evolution and git-diff paths first: lib/runtime/evolution/PluginOpportunisticEvolution.ts, lib/service/evolution/git-diff-checkpoint/GitDiffScanner.ts and index/status helpers, lib/runtime/mcp/host/opportunistic-evolution-presenter.ts, lib/runtime/mcp/HostMcpServer.ts callPluginOwnedTool attachment, Plan/testMode/module-mining paths under lib/recipe-generation and host-agent-workflows, KnowledgeModule DI for SourceRefReconciler/EvolutionGateway/DecayDetector/PlanRepository, and relevant tests. (2) Reconnect trigger away from retired alembic_task close: HEAD-compare should run on relevant plugin-owned host-agent tool calls without daemon/watch/git hook behavior, with a bounded skip policy for read-only/no-project/no-git/unavailable contexts. Keep resident/main-service defer path where it is still meaningful, but do not make it a permanent no-op that prevents Plugin fallback when Plugin owns the current project. (3) Upgrade GitDiffScanner to produce deterministic HEAD range evidence: explicit git diff rename/copy detection with configurable default rename threshold 90% (`-M90%` plus copy detection where useful), include created/modified/deleted/renamed events with oldPath/newPath, head/headChanged/signature, and a persisted or container-scoped lastSeenCommit/signature checkpoint appropriate to existing Plugin runtime state. Handle non-ancestor lastSeen..HEAD by git merge-base check and return/trigger a rescan catch-up fallback signal rather than misclassifying; add a scale guard for giant commits with observable truncated/deferred status. (4) Implement unified classification/routing through existing Core services instead of a separate fixed-package/recommendation path: high-confidence rename/move -> SourceRefReconciler repair/applyRepairs/replaceSourcePath-style automatic pointer/path repair and immediate RecipeFreshnessService refresh, no proposal; rename+large-change or low-confidence rename -> repair safe pointer if possible plus EvolutionGateway update proposal; modified covered code -> EvolutionGateway update proposal with real file evidence; deleted covered code -> EvolutionGateway deprecate proposal, not deletion; created path in an existing covered module -> usually no-op or coverage note; created path in a new module/package/folder -> module-mining/scoped scan/recommendation signal using the accepted Plan/testMode/module-scope surfaces and Core DynamicSignalGateway/ModuleDelta outputs where available. (5) Ensure Plan remains authoritative without double-writing generation-state: write only existing DB sources (recipe_source_refs, evolution_proposals, lifecycle_transition_events, knowledge entries) so alembic_plan get/projection reflects state; do not create Plugin-local Plan generation state or directly persist codeRecipeMapping. Plan.intent/changeLog may be updated only for true intent changes, not as a mirror of generated state. (6) Surface bounded clean MCP output for opportunistic/unified evolution: status, scanned range, classification counts, repaired/proposed/deprecated/recommended/skipped, retrievalMayBeStale/freshness where affected, fallback reasons (merge-base catch-up, scale guard, vector degraded), and nextActions that point to existing tools without changing four public MCP business semantics. (7) Add focused tests covering GitDiffScanner -M/-C and default 90% threshold, non-ancestor merge-base fallback, scale guard, trigger no longer limited to alembic_task close, rename auto-repair vs low-confidence proposal boundary, modified/deleted proposal routing, new-module recommendation/scoped-scan signal, Plan projection/no-double-write boundary, clean-output contract additions, and no daemon/watch behavior. Boundaries: do not edit AlembicCore unless raw evidence proves the accepted public APIs are unusable; if Core is insufficient, return blocked/needs-review with the smallest Core repair request and evidence. Do not implement RG-9 cleanup, RG-10 BiliDili/Test run, Alembic main follow-on, daemon/resident watcher/hook behavior, or broad Recipe quality evaluation. Do not delete recipe_source_refs/evolution_proposals/lifecycle/vector evidence. Do not change four public MCP business semantics beyond additive diagnostic fields. If this slice is too broad for one target turn, return blocked/needs-review with a concrete split, but first implement the smallest real connected chain that proves commit-driven routing is no longer dead. Expected validation: npm run build:check; targeted tests for GitDiffScanner, PluginOpportunisticEvolution/unified routing, module-scope/Plan projection if touched, clean-output contracts; npm run lint; npm run lint:core-import-boundary; npm run lint:repo-boundary; npm run lint:layer-boundary; npm run verify:release-package-boundary; git diff --check; Alembic Guard over changed files. Return TargetResultEnvelope with commit hash, changed files, exact validation outputs, routing evidence, non-goals respected, risks, and RG-9/RG-10 eligibility notes.
